head: codex/5526-v0918-provider-expansion
title: [v0.91.8][WP-09][provider] Add current agentic model provider identities
body:
Closes #5526

Adds deterministic first-class provider profiles and stable model identities for Kimi K2.5, MiniMax M2.5, hosted Qwen3 Max, xAI/Grok 4.5, Mistral Medium 3.5/Small 4/Devstral 2, Cohere Command A+ and North Mini Code, DeepSeek V4, Z.ai GLM-5, and Gemini 3.1.

The shared HTTP adapter preserves legacy generic HTTP behavior while using profile-declared chat payloads and vendor-specific response shapes for the expanded lanes. Vendor identity overrides fail closed, and direct provider routes remain distinct from OpenRouter and local Ollama/vLLM compatibility lanes.

Validation: focused provider tests passed, strict Clippy passed, cargo fmt --check passed, and git diff --check passed. No credentials, live provider calls, AWS, or Bedrock execution was used.
